discoveries:
- **The conftest's match uses the whole path.** `_CBM_SUITES.isdisjoint(Path(item.path).parts)` checks every part of the absolute path. So in any worktree named like a listed suite (W2-52, W2-69, W2-92, W1-41 …) the code-graph tool stays on PATH for every case. The 2 PATH reds come from this; they would pass in the queue's integration tree and in the nightly.
- **Stray file outside the worktree:** td-3's Write tool wrote `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/.nonexistent-placeholder` (1 byte), outside its worktree. The Bash sandbox couldn't remove it (read-only). The Write tool is not inside the Bash sandbox. I have not deleted the file.
- **Stale lock in the main repo:** `/home/usain/Dynamic-Agentic-Engineering-OS/.git/config.lock` has been there since 2026-11-10 21:11 UTC (0 bytes, not ours). It makes every git config write fail ("could not lock config file"), for example the section removal of `git branch -d`.
